own_membership_outside_tenant.name: own_membership_outside_tenant
own_membership_outside_tenant.using:
nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') is null
        and "memberships"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')

own_tenants_outside_tenant.name: own_tenants_outside_tenant
own_tenants_outside_tenant.using:
nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') is null
      and exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
         where m.tenant_id = "tenants"."id"
           and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')
      )

buildings_short_code_shaped.name: buildings_short_code_shaped
buildings_short_code_shaped.value: "buildings"."short_code" is null or ("buildings"."short_code" = btrim("buildings"."short_code") and char_length("buildings"."short_code") between 1 and 20)

rooms_number_shaped.name: rooms_number_shaped
rooms_number_shaped.value: "rooms"."number" is null or ("rooms"."number" = btrim("rooms"."number") and char_length("rooms"."number") between 1 and 30)

rooms_name_shaped.name: rooms_name_shaped
rooms_name_shaped.value: "rooms"."name" is null or ("rooms"."name" = btrim("rooms"."name") and char_length("rooms"."name") between 1 and 120)

rooms_use_shaped.name: rooms_use_shaped
rooms_use_shaped.value: "rooms"."use" is null or ("rooms"."use" = btrim("rooms"."use") and char_length("rooms"."use") between 1 and 120)

rooms_named.name: rooms_named
rooms_named.value: "rooms"."number" is not null or "rooms"."name" is not null
